details: The Bitget cryptocurrency exchange experienced a major security breach on September 24, 2026, with unauthorized transfers initially estimated at $351.6 million, later updated to $387.5 million after tracing additional assets. The exchange temporarily suspended withdrawals but confirmed that user funds are safe and covered by its protection fund. Investigations are ongoing, with some ties to a North Korean hacking group being explored.
title: Bitget Exchange Suffers Significant Hack, User Funds Secured

details: U.S. spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) recorded a net inflow of $134 million on September 25, 2026, extending their inflow streak to seven consecutive days. BlackRock's IBIT led these inflows with $96.99 million, followed by Fidelity's FBTC with $49.32 million. The total net asset value of Bitcoin spot ETFs has now reached $108.42 billion.
title: Bitcoin Spot ETFs See Seventh Consecutive Day of Inflows

details: Ethereum spot ETFs also saw positive momentum, with a net inflow of $86.95 million on September 25, 2026. This marks the sixth consecutive day of inflows for Ethereum ETFs, with BlackRock's ETHA leading with $50.37 million.
title: Ethereum Spot ETFs Record Sixth Day of Inflows

details: Several altcoins, including Litecoin, Cardano, Stellar, and Chainlink, outperformed Bitcoin over the past week, with gains ranging from 17% to 29%. Bitcoin's dominance (its share of the total crypto market value) has dipped to 58.5% as of September 26, falling below the 60% threshold. While Glassnode's Altcoin Cycle Signal is high at 81.25, the broader Altcoin Season Index remains neutral, indicating capital flow into altcoins but not yet a full-blown "altseason."
title: Altcoins Outperform Bitcoin as Dominance Declines, Signaling "Altcoin Season" Potential

details: CyphaLab launched a unified financial operating layer on September 25, 2026, designed to seamlessly connect institutional capital markets with decentralized finance (DeFi). This new infrastructure aims to address challenges in real-world asset (RWA) tokenization, such as fragmented order reconciliation and custody friction, as global financial institutions increasingly move towards tokenized assets.
title: CyphaLab Unveils Infrastructure for Institutional RWA Tokenization
